evaluation: The nine datasets were selected after C4 outcomes; all their episode parities are now exposed development data; no fresh confirmation claim.
tools: All contraptions hypothetical. Prior context flags overlap, not full novelty audits. No policy runs were performed.

modules.name: Periodic sentinel
modules.implementation: After cutoff, buy one disagreement label every m eligible events.
modules.hypothesis: Detect late advantage reversals with minimal spend.

modules.name: Geometric sentinel
modules.implementation: After cutoff, grow the sentinel interval geometrically until a warning resets it.
modules.hypothesis: Save more labels during long stable intervals.

modules.name: Hazard-responsive sentinel
modules.implementation: Set sentinel probability using a posterior change hazard, with an irreducible floor.
modules.hypothesis: Spend monitoring budget when latent changes are more likely.

modules.name: Disagreement CUSUM
modules.implementation: Track prediction-only disagreement indicator with a two-sided CUSUM; reopen a bounded query window on alarm.
modules.hypothesis: Detect distribution shift without paid labels.

modules.name: Disagreement Page-Hinkley
modules.implementation: Apply Page-Hinkley to the online prediction-disagreement rate; reopen on alarm.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid a static post-cutoff purchase schedule.

modules.name: Prediction-pair transition alarm
modules.implementation: Monitor frequencies of observable (0,1) versus (1,0) model-output patterns.
modules.hypothesis: Capture regime changes invisible to total disagreement frequency.

modules.name: Disagreement burst alarm
modules.implementation: Compare short versus long disagreement-frequency EWMAs and reopen on a burst.
modules.hypothesis: Increase label buys during unstable model-output periods.

modules.name: Prediction turnover alarm
modules.implementation: Detect a change in each model's observed prediction-flip frequency (not label error).
modules.hypothesis: Use free prediction streams to trigger monitoring.
modules.prior_context: proposal; may track context not quality

modules.name: Feedback-staleness sentinel
modules.implementation: Force a disagreement query if no released informative label has arrived for m events.
modules.hypothesis: Prevent an early posterior from permanently suppressing data.

modules.name: One-shot reopening window
modules.implementation: At predeclared checkpoints past cutoff, reopen for W events under a reserved budget.
modules.hypothesis: Cover late shifts more efficiently than constant sentinels.

modules.name: Maximum eligible-query gap
modules.implementation: Never leave more than G disagreement opportunities without buying one label.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid change-blind evidence starvation.

modules.name: Randomized minimum propensity
modules.implementation: Impose positive acquisition probability p_min after cutoff before horizon-feasibility check.
modules.hypothesis: Protect against zero-support feedback policies.

modules.name: Split-period budget reserve
modules.implementation: Reserve a fixed fraction of the 200 labels for t>800.
modules.hypothesis: Preserve capacity to recover late.

modules.name: Post-promotion reserve
modules.implementation: Reserve a small packet of labels for the first W events after model-1 promotion.
modules.hypothesis: Detect false promotion before losses compound.

modules.name: Post-reversal reserve
modules.implementation: Reserve queries immediately after returning to model 0.
modules.hypothesis: Check whether rollback itself was premature.

modules.name: Pending-queue cap
modules.implementation: Suppress redundant acquisition when too many already-requested disagreement labels are in flight.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid paying twice before evidence can arrive.
modules.prior_context: existing stake variant uses pending cap

modules.name: Pending-age priority
modules.implementation: Prefer query windows where queued labels are unlikely to arrive early enough to change an action.
modules.hypothesis: Improve value per released observation.

modules.name: Posterior-uncertainty pacing
modules.implementation: Multiply the parent query propensity by a clipped posterior-variance score.
modules.hypothesis: Shift buying toward uncertainty rather than uniform pacing.

modules.name: Decision-boundary proximity pacing
modules.implementation: Increase buying near the original EQSDp payback boundary, but retain a nonzero sentinel floor.
modules.hypothesis: Buy labels most likely to affect switching while avoiding old C1 lock-in.
modules.prior_context: C1 proximity mechanism failed without insurance

modules.name: Prediction-pattern stratified acquisition
modules.implementation: Maintain separate acquisition quotas for (0,1) and (1,0) disagreement patterns.
modules.hypothesis: Reduce skew when the direction of disagreement changes.

modules.name: Fast/slow Beta evidence blend
modules.implementation: Maintain two discounted Beta counts and combine their switching signals, preserving the original EQSDp as default.
modules.hypothesis: React to abrupt changes without excessive stationary variance.

modules.name: Surprise-triggered discount
modules.implementation: Temporarily decrease lambda after low-probability released-label outcomes.
modules.hypothesis: Recover from stale posterior lock-in.

modules.name: Soft posterior reset
modules.implementation: Shrink old discounted counts toward their prior after an observable released-feedback change alarm.
modules.hypothesis: Remove incorrect old evidence without full reset.
modules.prior_context: reset ideas related to earlier screens

modules.name: Hazard-mixture Beta filter
modules.implementation: Use a stable-versus-redraw posterior mixture to adjust the evidence summary.
modules.hypothesis: Make sudden changes less surprising to the decision rule.

modules.name: Bayesian run-length posterior
modules.implementation: Track the posterior since last likely change using only released disagreement outcomes.
modules.hypothesis: Weight post-change observations more heavily.

modules.name: Two-regime hidden-state belief
modules.implementation: Infer latent persistent challenger-better versus incumbent-better regimes.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid treating transient and persistent advantages equally.

modules.name: Dependence-adjusted effective sample size
modules.implementation: Reduce effective Beta counts as observed label autocorrelation rises.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid overconfident switching in correlated streams.
modules.prior_context: G/ESS correction previously tied or lost

modules.name: Request-time discount correction
modules.implementation: Discount a released label according to its event timestamp rather than only its release order.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid stale delayed-label updates appearing artificially fresh.

modules.name: Robust Beta prior ensemble
modules.implementation: Average or take a conservative envelope across weak and concentrated Beta priors.
modules.hypothesis: Reduce sensitivity to early small samples.

modules.name: Joint disagreement-and-win-rate belief
modules.implementation: Maintain separate Beta filters for observable disagreement probability and conditional challenger win rate.
modules.hypothesis: Improve payback estimates when disagreement frequency shifts.
modules.prior_context: the parent already estimates both separately

modules.name: Two-observation promotion confirmation
modules.implementation: After parent proposes promotion, require one additional informative released disagreement before switching.
modules.hypothesis: Reduce expensive false promotions.

modules.name: Reversible probation after promotion
modules.implementation: Apply a short probation phase with elevated monitoring and conditional rollback.
modules.hypothesis: Reduce error exposure after mistaken promotion.

modules.name: Fast negative-evidence rollback
modules.implementation: During probation, reverse when an observed short-window loss gap is strongly adverse.
modules.hypothesis: Shorten expensive bad deployments.

modules.name: Direction-specific conservative quantiles
modules.implementation: Use separate promotion and reversal gamma values around original baseline gamma.
modules.hypothesis: Balance missed adoption versus false reversal.

modules.name: Switch-count-dependent hurdle
modules.implementation: Increase marginal switch cost in the decision rule following repeated reversals.
modules.hypothesis: Suppress churn without blocking the first beneficial adoption.

modules.name: Persistence-adjusted payback
modules.implementation: Replace raw remaining horizon by expected duration of the advantage under a hazard model.
modules.hypothesis: Prevent adoption of a fleeting improvement.

modules.name: Alarm-conditioned emergency promotion
modules.implementation: After a strong label-based change alarm, reduce the promotion hurdle for a bounded window.
modules.hypothesis: Recover faster from abrupt advantage changes.

modules.name: Query-burst confirmation before switching
modules.implementation: When payback is near the hurdle, buy a brief evidence packet then decide.
modules.hypothesis: Improve timing of high-impact uncertain switches.

modules.name: Horizon-dependent quantile level
modules.implementation: Vary risk tolerance through the episode while leaving Beta evidence and payback structure intact.
modules.hypothesis: Trade early adaptation against late overfitting.

modules.name: Posterior no-action switch band
modules.implementation: Require additional predicted incremental benefit when posterior uncertainty makes repeated switching likely.
modules.hypothesis: Reduce low-value reversals while protecting strong signals.

modules.name: Missed-switch expected-loss proxy
modules.implementation: Estimate downside of withholding another label under a finite-horizon future-change mixture.
modules.hypothesis: Prevent 600-unit missed promotions that dwarf label fees.
modules.prior_context: one-step R2 tested; must improve model

modules.name: Paired-cost tail-aware acquisition
modules.implementation: Purchase labels when estimated upper-tail excess cost of skipping is high.
modules.hypothesis: Protect rare high-cost episodes.

modules.name: Posterior risk budget per deployment
modules.implementation: Track posterior expected downside of wrong switches against a preallocated loss budget.
modules.hypothesis: Spend caution only when downside budget is tight.

modules.name: Prior-robust payback envelope
modules.implementation: Check economic benefit under multiple posterior priors before allowing a risky state change.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid optimistic transitions driven by a single assumed prior.

modules.name: Ambiguity-triggered parent fallback
modules.implementation: If an add-on decision is too uncertain, use frozen EQSDp+cutoff behaviour.
modules.hypothesis: Keep the parent's strong default performance.

modules.name: Positive-propensity feedback correction
modules.implementation: Use capped inverse-propensity weighted statistics for diagnostics or decision calibration where valid.
modules.hypothesis: Reduce informative-label selection bias when acquisition becomes adaptive.

modules.name: Released-loss CUSUM monitor
modules.implementation: Apply CUSUM to purchased-label signs, with explicit delay and monitoring floor.
modules.hypothesis: Detect switching advantage reversals from actual loss evidence.

modules.name: Next-information arrival value
modules.implementation: Penalize actions that rely on evidence arriving after the last economically useful switch time.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid buying or switching on information that cannot pay back.

modules.name: Posterior lock-in detector
modules.implementation: Flag high-confidence states with few recent labels and force monitoring.
modules.hypothesis: Prevent self-confirming starvation after an early stationary belief.

modules.name: Observed-regret risk score
modules.implementation: Compute a downside proxy from purchased-label regret, carefully respecting query propensities.
modules.hypothesis: Estimate risky deployment intervals without hidden labels.
modules.prior_context: proposal; not true realized unlabeled regret

modules.name: Front-loaded startup pulse
modules.implementation: Spend a small fixed packet before first actionable delayed feedback.
modules.hypothesis: Improve the first high-value promotion decision.

modules.name: Backloaded adaptive evidence pulse
modules.implementation: Keep budget for a predeclared late evidence pulse after cutoff.
modules.hypothesis: Detect later regime reversals.

modules.name: Alarm-triggered reserve release
modules.implementation: Unlock a protected budget reserve when free or paid change alarms fire.
modules.hypothesis: Concentrate expensive monitoring on likely shifts.

modules.name: Sequential surprise query burst
modules.implementation: After two surprising released labels, temporarily raise query propensity.
modules.hypothesis: Verify whether change is persistent.

modules.name: Unlabeled/labeled sensor fusion
modules.implementation: Require agreement or Bayesian fusion between prediction-pattern alarms and released-loss alarms.
modules.hypothesis: Reduce spurious triggers while capturing true shifts.
modules.prior_context: proposal; model-output may not track loss

modules.name: Sentinel-to-rollback cascade
modules.implementation: A post-cutoff sentinel surprise triggers high-rate querying plus rapid rollback review.
modules.hypothesis: Combine cheap monitoring with costly-deployment containment.

modules.name: Alarm-gated fast/slow evidence
modules.implementation: Use fast Beta counts only after a change warning, otherwise retain parent evidence.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid the stationary variance penalty of permanent fast forgetting.

modules.name: Two-policy economic arbitration
modules.implementation: Maintain parent and experimental policy states; use released labels to select action cautiously, charging all switches.
modules.hypothesis: Avoid catastrophic regressions from an unstable add-on.
modules.prior_context: proposal; requires full state and selection audit

modules.name: Lightweight learned acquisition controller
modules.implementation: Train a small threshold policy on observable state features, then freeze it on a development fold.
modules.hypothesis: Learn interactions too complex for hand-tuned rules.

modules.name: Multi-label short-rollout VOI
modules.implementation: Estimate net value of a bundle of 2–4 future labels, conditional on their arrival times.
modules.hypothesis: One label may not cross a switch threshold although a packet could.
modules.prior_context: R2-roll k=2,3 tried; tied on odd
